description: TikTok profile lookup: followers, likes, bio, verified, engagement rate, avg views, posting cadence and recent videos. Use to get public numbers for a TikTok account. Returns name, bio, verified, followers, following, posts, metrics {engagementRate, avgViews, viewRate, postsPerWeek, tier} and recentPosts[] with likes, comments and views. Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

handle.description: Handle (with or without @) or profile URL, e.g. virat.kohli, https://www.tiktok.com/@khaby.lame, @MrBeast or a YouTube channel id (UC...)

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest data you accept, 1-720 hours (default 72). Fresher than that is fetched live

name: social_tiktok

fetchedAt.description: When the data was captured, ISO 8601

growth30d.description: Instagram only: follower change over about 30 days; null without history

history.description: Instagram only: past snapshots, oldest first

recentPosts.description: Empty when served from the creator index
